title: Fixed texts (versioned)
description: Every text the system shows that is not LLM-generated: entry/page, consent, disclaimers, opening, goal templates, outcomes, red flags, FAQ answers, errors, WhatsApp texts, Hadas-summary and feedback-page texts. Wording: conversation designer (role 3); clinical meaning: Hadas; legal gate: lawyer. Mapping from texts.he.md: heading `id@vN` -> key `id`, version N; '>' lines -> text; subject suffixes (.self/.child.m/.child.f/.child.n/.other) -> variants (self/child_m/child_f/child_n/other); the scale mark -> legal_review=required. Each text has its own integer version, bumped on ANY change to its text or variants; old versions stay in git history and the consent log / traces store (id, version, sha256 of the rendered string). The schema enforces the legal gate: an 'approved' text with legal_review=required must carry a lawyer approval. Allowed markup: newlines, '**bold**', '[label](url)' with url on the output-rules allowlist. Placeholders use {{snake_case}} (texts.he.md convention), must be declared, and must never be glued to a Hebrew prefix letter. File: intake/content/fixed-texts.he.json. Round 5: 'active' (default true). An inactive text is kept and versioned but never rendered (e.g. outcome 3 while outcome3_enabled is false, D-03; the two-box consent alternative; goal.other_awareness.ask). The production approval gate (status approved, lawyer for the scale mark) applies to ACTIVE texts only; switching a feature on (e.g. outcome3_enabled: true) makes intake:check require its texts active and approved. Mapping from texts.he.md: a '**סטטוס:** לא פעיל — <reason>' line -> active: false (the reason stays in notes).

variants.description: Alternative wordings, same version. Keys: channel (web|whatsapp), subject (self|child_m|child_f|child_n|other), or channel.subject. Resolution order: channel.subject -> subject -> child_n (for child_m/child_f) -> channel -> text.

placeholders.description: Names used as {{name}} in text/variants. Each must resolve from faq.json facts, deployment config, or the engine (see ARCHITECTURE.md placeholder registry).

purpose_he.description: Where/when it is shown (screen or step), for reviewers.

client_bundle.description: true = compiled at build time into the frontend's generated text module, never hand-copied (CI fails if it differs). Rule: every text the client renders WITHOUT a server response, or that is pure UI chrome: chat.* (header, input, send, typing, slow, not_sent, new_message, quick replies, stage labels, end/delete dialogs, chat.disclaimer_line, chat.ended, chat.delete.done, chat.input.too_long_hint, chat.input.too_long_block), resume.* (S2, incl. the 'already sent' state shown from the local marker), closed.keep_note, menu.*, dialog.*, a11y.*, ui.*, error.*, nav.*, and the offline safety set (system.unavailable, static fallback.*, redflag.title.*, redflag.type.*, redflag.footer, redflag.cta.call*). Consent/S1, goal, outcome, routing-stop, FAQ, form and confirmation texts are always served by the server so their versions can be logged. Bundle texts are versioned by the deploy's fixed_texts content version and follow the same legal gate.

active.description: false = kept for a feature that is off; never rendered; exempt from the production approval gate until switched on. Requires notes (the reason).
